records.title: GPT for Games: An Updated Scoping Review (2020–2024)
records.reason: This scoping review surveys GPT applications in games; it does not address inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: SPICEPilot: Navigating SPICE Code Generation and Simulation with AI Guidance
records.reason: SPICEPilot is a circuit-generation dataset and benchmark for LLM code generation, focused on capability/accuracy rather than model inference efficiency.

records.title: SSD4Rec: A Structured State Space Duality Model for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
records.reason: SSD4Rec is a Mamba-based sequential recommendation model; its task and evaluation are recommender systems, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Edge and Terminal Cooperation Enabled LLM Deployment Optimization in Wireless Network
records.reason: The abstract indicates a direct LLM edge/terminal inference optimization, but the primary full text was inaccessible after checking the DOI and IEEE Xplore record; method and experimental evidence therefore remain unverified.

records.title: HyQ: Hardware-Friendly Post-Training Quantization for CNN-Transformer Hybrid Networks
records.reason: HyQ quantizes CNN-transformer hybrid vision models for image classification and FPGA resource reduction; it is not an LLM inference/serving method.
